title: gate-oracle-foundation

gateContract.ruleStatement: The oracle-foundation gate verdict is the source of truth for whether the Phase 02 oracle foundation is ready for downstream parity work. The gate walks every JSON file under test/oracles/fixtures/, deeply searches for any string value whose content starts with the literal substring 'pending-', and reports both the list of blocked fixture paths and the per-occurrence JSON pointer + string value. The gate passes only when no fixture contains any pending-* value.
gateContract.currentVerdict: blocked (17 of 31 fixtures still contain pending-* values pending live reference capture); the 02-010 BLOCKED_FIXTURES_AUTHORITATIVE_REGISTRY enumerates each blocked fixture with rationale + followUpStepId=02-011 explaining that this gate is the completion check for the oracle foundation
gateContract.selfValidationStrategy: The focused test does not assert the gate currently passes — it asserts the gate REPORTS state correctly. If passes=true, blockedCount must be 0; if passes=false, blockedCount must be >0. Internal consistency between blockedFixtureRelativePaths and pendingOccurrences is enforced. This lets the test ship today (verifying the gate function works) while remaining the canonical pass/fail oracle for downstream acceptance work that replaces pending-* values one fixture at a time.

scopeNote: This step ships the gate function and the focused-test contract. It does NOT replace the 17 currently-blocked fixtures with live evidence — that work is owned by the downstream capture-binding steps that 02-010's BLOCKED_FIXTURES_AUTHORITATIVE_REGISTRY enumerates via the followUpStepId field. The final side-by-side acceptance gate (plan_final 12-*) re-runs this same gate function and requires passes=true before signing off.
